incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A collapsed multi-story building with rubble and debris scattered around, showing significant structural damage. Other buildings and vegetation are visible in the background.

observations.description: A building is completely collapsed with exposed interior and roof sections.
A tall dark pole stands near the rubble. Other buildings are visible in the background.
A tree is visible in the background, along with some bushes and plants near the rubble.
A white sack and various pieces of wood and metal are scattered among the rubble.
